import json, sys, subprocess, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'nuvem'))
from benchmark import solver_bridge as bridge
from benchmark.runner import evaluate_project
from benchmark.extract.from_solver import project_from_solver
m=bridge.engine()
prior=json.loads((root/'docs/checkpoints/evidence/beta-baseline-replay.json').read_text())
old,new=[{r['wall'] for r in z['score']['per_wall'] if r['compensators']=='FAIL'} for z in prior['results'][:2]]
selected=(new-old)|(old-new)
p=root/'nuvem/benchmark/projects/torre_easy_lo_r00_tgd'
data=json.loads((p/'input.json').read_text());reference=json.loads((p/'reference.json').read_text())
out=[]
def key(a,b):return tuple(sorted(tuple(round(x,3) for x in point) for point in (a,b)))
for stage in ['main','n1f']:
 s=json.loads((root/('docs/checkpoints/evidence/beta-'+stage+'-tgd.json')).read_text())
 nodes,walls,ends,openings=bridge.plan_from_input(data)
 catalog,_,_=bridge.catalog_from_input(data)
 for c in s['candidates']:
  for k in ('origin_world','x_dir','y_dir'):c[k]=m.XYZ(*c[k])
 rows={int(ci):[s['candidates'][i] for i in row['candidates']] for ci,row in s['physical'].items()}
 project=project_from_solver(s['project'],{'course_candidates':rows},walls,nodes,openings,catalog,0,len(rows))
 findings,score,_=evaluate_project(project,reference)
 assert score['findings_by_code']==next(z['score']['findings_by_code'] for z in prior['results'] if z['stage']==stage and z['project'].endswith('tgd'))
 source_map={}
 for wi,(line,thickness,locks) in enumerate(walls):
  a,b=line.GetEndPoint(0),line.GetEndPoint(1)
  k=key([a.X*30.48,a.Y*30.48],[b.X*30.48,b.Y*30.48])
  assert k not in source_map
  source_map[k]=wi
 records=[]
 for wall in project['walls']:
  if wall['id'] not in selected:continue
  wi=source_map[key(wall['start_cm'],wall['end_cm'])]
  relevant=[f for f in findings if f.get('wall')==wall['id'] and f.get('validator')=='compensators']
  records.append({'result_wall_id':wall['id'],'source_wall_index':wi,'wall_key':s['wall_keys'][wi],'start_cm':wall['start_cm'],'end_cm':wall['end_cm'],'direction':'new_failure' if wall['id'] in new-old else 'resolved_failure','codes':dict(Counter(f['code'] for f in relevant)),'findings':relevant})
 out.append({'stage':stage,'source_head':s['head'],'walls':records})
 print(json.dumps({'stage':stage,'walls':[{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='findings'} for r in records]}))
payload={'head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'scope':'Result IDs mapped back to original physical axes by exact rounded coordinates, not matched to source IDs by name. All unchanged validators with official reference.','added_result_ids':sorted(new-old),'removed_result_ids':sorted(old-new),'results':out}
with (root/'docs/checkpoints/evidence/beta-compensator-wall-delta.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(payload,f,indent=2)
